items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Fuqua and Jerry, Jeter, Pillars and Chester Clark and myself got in my car and we all decided to go back to Cleveland, because we had been there.

ctx.x: What about Swan Lake, were you playing Swan Lake?
Oh, we played that. Those were one nighters. We played Swan Lake and quite a few places.

When the band broke up--we also played the Hilltop there in Schenectady--the Hilltop is the name of the club--Well anyway, how the Inkspots were started, when the band broke up, I had this car and Charlie Fuqua and Jerry, Jeter, Pillars and Chester Clark and myself got in my car and we all decided to go back to Cleveland, because we had been there.

items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: His brother came in in '27. ... he joined us later.

ctx.x: Now, Charles Pillars, I didn't think Charles Pillars came in the band the same time his brother did. I thought he came in later.
